welcome.title: Welcome to ReelBolt
welcome.body: This menu takes you to your projects, the editor and your settings. On a phone it sits behind the menu button at the top.

newProject.title: Start with a project
newProject.body: A project is a folder for one video job. Create one, then add your clips, pictures or audio to it.

apps.title: Pick an app and run it
apps.body: Inside a project, the Apps tab lists what you can make. Choose one, set a few options and press Run.

appsOff.title: Pick an app and run it
appsOff.body: Inside a project, the Workflows tab lists what you can run. Choose one, set a few options and press Run.

progress.title: Watch it work
progress.body: Each run shows its progress as it goes. You can leave the page: your video keeps going and the result is waiting when you are back.

assistant.title: Ask the assistant
assistant.body: Not sure where to start? Ask in your own words. The assistant can explain things, suggest next steps and check with you before it changes anything.

editor.title: Fine-tune in the editor
editor.body: Open a finished video to trim, reorder and add text. The editor is an Early preview, so some things are still being polished.

pictures.title: Pictures and thumbnails
pictures.body: Make a cover picture or thumbnail for your video from the same place, then download it or use it in your video.

credits.title: Credits and your plan
credits.body: Runs use credits. Open this menu to see your plan and balance, and to take this tour again any time.

tour.learnMore: Learn more (opens in a new tab)

checklist.title: Getting started
checklist.doneBody: You have tried everything on the list. Nicely done.
checklist.assistantPrompt: What can I do from the dashboard? Suggest the most useful next step given my projects and recent runs.

tourCard.title: New here? Take a look around
tourCard.body: A short tour of the menu, the assistant and where your videos land. It stays in the Help and account menus if you would rather do it later.

firstFilm.title: Make your first film
firstFilm.body: Never made one here? We add a short sample clip to a new project and open the app ready to go. You press Run when you want to; nothing starts by itself.
firstFilm.failedTitle: Could not set up your first film
firstFilm.projectDescription: A sample clip to try the highlight edit app.

error.unverified: Confirm your email address first: open the link we sent you, then try again.
error.tooLarge: Your storage is full, so the sample clip could not be added. Free some space and try again.
error.network: We could not reach ReelBolt. Check your connection and try again.
error.generic: Please try again in a moment.
